title: ScVal bytes whose length prefix is 0x40000000 (1 GiB) at the end of the input
caps_note: A cross-cutting encoding rule rather than a CAP: it applies to every XDR value of every protocol
why: The length prefix promises 1073741824 bytes that the input does not contain. A decoder must compare the length with the remaining input before allocating; one that allocates first can be made to request 1 GiB by a few bytes of input.

source.reason: A bytes length of 0x40000000 at the end of the input; core checks the length against the input before allocating

known_divergences.detail: Executed: under prlimit --as=1GiB, v0.7.1 allocates the claimed length before reading and the Go runtime aborts with 'out of memory'; v0.7.2 rejects with 'data exceeds max slice limit'. Without the cap, in a fresh process, v0.7.1 rejects (the allocation is never touched).
known_divergences.evidence: the evidence/sdk-matrix probe, executed on extra as_limit (vector 6h4, v0.7.1 [prlimit --as=1GiB]); the evidence/sdk-matrix probe, executed on go v0.7.1

known_divergences.profile: limits-none under address-space cap RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB
known_divergences.detail: Executed on 28.0.0, 28.0.1 and 30.0.0 under limits-none (Limits::none()) with RLIMIT_AS 1 GiB: BytesM allocates the length the prefix claims before reading the body, and the process aborts ('memory allocation of … bytes failed'). Under limits-default the length budget refuses the input before allocating (LengthLimitExceeded); without the cap the allocation is lazy and the decode is refused (UnexpectedEof). Hardening for callers that decode with limits disabled.

The XDR-JSON column decodes with Limits::none(), as the crate's own stellar-xdr decode does: BytesM allocates the length the prefix claims before reading the body and the process aborts under the 1 GiB cap.

notes: Probe vector 6h4 (evidence/sdk-matrix/vectors/vectors.json); it was run under the 1 GiB memory cap and under an address-space cap.

core_behaviour.evidence: stellar-core 30.0.0 print-xdr --filetype scval on the blob, run by hand for this entry: "Could not decode with type 'scval' : insufficient buffer space in xdr_generic_get"
